input.question: Why is Judaism one of the major world religions now that there are only 15 million of them?
input.ground_truth: There's nothing that makes one religion "major" at the exclusion of another. It's not like there's an official list. Judaism is historically important as the precursor to Christianity and Islam. It is also a culturally and politically important group in much of the Western world.
